## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any affected contract or issue.

## Validation

Record the checks run and their scope. Identify any browser, desktop, cloud or
consumer qualification still required. Local fixtures do not prove live use.

## Release impact

Note config, protocol, dependency, image or migration changes, and update the
changelog and canonical docs when the shipped behavior changes. Keep credentials,
bindings and private qualification output out of the diff.
